editorial.blurb: This casual Riverwalk brewhouse serves satisfying Chicago classics with killer views and a convivial atmosphere—perfect for soaking in the river scene with a drink in hand.
editorial.insiderTip: Go for lunch on a weekday when it's quieter and you'll snag a table easily; the big pretzel and Chicago hot dog are the standouts, and portions are reasonable for the prime location.

topDishes.note: Served super hot and beloved by reviewers
Yummy and indulgent, a standout favorite
